current_objective: Build and verify the approved dark-theme standalone Sam-Sebe-RPG one-file playable with embedded visuals, deterministic living-world progression and portable saves.
next_action: Persist the tested standalone implementation source and exact HTML artifact into experiment/standalone-html-v1 from an environment that supports local-file repository upload, then rerun the same standalone verification from that checkout.
blockers: The managed Chromium policy blocks direct file:// navigation, so exact file:// persistence could not be exercised in this runtime; the final artifact is structurally self-contained and browser-smoke-tested by loading the exact document into Chromium.

The current GitHub connector accepts text content but not a local sandbox file path, while the sandbox itself has no outbound GitHub network access. Therefore the tested implementation source and binary-derived HTML artifact are delivered to the user and recorded by hash, but are not yet fully materialized in the experiment branch.

last_handoff.result: Built and verified a playable one-file dark-theme Sam-Sebe-RPG standalone v1. The artifact includes three save slots with backup recovery/import/export, keyboard and touch controls, village and tavern SVG scenes, Oren's three-firewood quest, deterministic world progression, Talen arrival at tick 10, causal Talen-to-Oren eastern-road knowledge transfer, event journal, dialogue UI, developer controls, and embedded generated concept art. The exact downloadable artifact was delivered in chat.
verification: Final Node test run: 13 passed, 0 failed.
Final browser smoke: PASS using the exact built HTML document in Chromium.
Browser route completed with real keyboard/UI actions: new slot -> tavern -> Oren quest -> collect 3 wood -> return -> 10 coin reward -> wait -> Talen appears -> eastern-road event reaches Oren.
Final build contains no runtime http:// or https:// dependency, no external script/style tags and no unresolved build markers.
Visual QA screenshots of the title and completed gameplay route were inspected.
Experiment branch records the approved spec, implementation plan, and exact artifact manifest at cd5b55accea05283338ce043fb68bd122ebb9038.

known_limitations: The server-backed integration candidate remains a separate line and its release-gate state is unchanged by this standalone experiment.
Direct file:// persistence needs one target-browser human check because this managed Chromium blocks file:// by administrator policy.
Standalone implementation source and exact artifact still need repository materialization from an environment with local-file upload/push support.
A real human experience check should decide whether standalone becomes the primary client direction.
